records.text: TPUSA took three months to respond to Candace Owens but gave her only 24 hours to respond to its debate invitation
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep DqGNvi36ol8)

appearances.snippet: TPUSA takes them three months to respond. ... Also TPUSA, you have 24 hours to respond.

verification.notes: The episode exactly preserves the anonymous commenter’s three-month/24-hour comparison, and Owens separately says she was given a 24-hour response period. Contemporary reporting corroborates the 24-hour deadline. No direct TPUSA record or other reliable source located substantiates the commenter’s three-month comparison, so the legacy fully-true determination is not carried forward.
